text.tspan: How the premium is priced, on chain
The Stylus pricer replays 504 real weekends against the layer and prices what it would have paid.
Friday close → Monday open, in bps
loss = Σ losing legs of position × gap × scale
What the layer would have paid:
Treaty charges at least 0.5% of the limit
v3: priced once per slice, first-loss + senior
